claim: Ele descreve o IPF Classic Worlds como o nível mais alto que o powerlifting raw e drug-free tem a oferecer.
verbatim: competing at the highest level that powerlifting uh raw powerlifting and drug-free powerlifting has to offer

claim: O Mundial não saiu como planejado e foi a maior adversidade que ele já enfrentou, dentro e fora da competição.
verbatim: the meat didn't go exactly as planned um honestly it was uh as much adversity as I think I've ever had uh both outside and inside of meat

claim: Ele passou mal por causa de comida ingerida 2 dias antes e chegou cerca de 10 lb abaixo do peso que queria.
verbatim: ended up getting uh sick from some food that I ate 2 days before and came in uh about 10 lbs under uh kind of the weight I wanted to be at

claim: Comendo e bebendo ele recuperou até 103,5 kg de peso corporal, ainda bem abaixo do que vinha pesando.
verbatim: I was able to eat and drink my way back up to 103 and a half kilog but that was well under what I had been at before

claim: Ele atribui ao tamanho da variação de peso corporal o maior impacto sofrido, e diz que isso pesou principalmente no agachamento.
verbatim: it was quite a a body weight change which I think impacted me the most on the squat

claim: Entrando no agachamento ele estava preocupado em validar o próprio abridor.
verbatim: honestly going into squats I was worried about making my opener

claim: No último terço do agachamento ele teve que se inclinar para trás com o tronco porque o peso estava começando a empurrá-lo à frente.
verbatim: I end up having to kind of lean back with my upper body and that's because the weight was starting to push me over

claim: O ritmo daquele Mundial deixou muito pouco tempo entre agachamento e supino: cerca de 3 minutos de descanso antes de ter que começar os aquecimentos.
verbatim: there was very little time in between Squat and bench basically uh you had about 3 minutes to rest before you'd have to start your warm-ups

claim: Depois do agachamento ele teve que sentar porque estava desmaiando, e foi o mais cansado e fatigado que já esteve.
verbatim: actually had to sit down I was fortunate that a chair was there in the back room CU I was blacking out and that is definitely the most tired and fatigued I have ever been

claim: Os treinadores lhe deram eletrólitos, ele estava bastante depletado, e o quadro começou a virar a partir dali.
verbatim: they got me some emergency and got some uh electrolytes in me and uh apparently I was pretty depleted but things started to turn around after that point

claim: No aquecimento de supino, mesmo o equivalente a 135 lb já lhe dava visão de túnel durante as repetições.
verbatim: warm-ups initially were very difficult even like 135 or or what the equivalent to that would be in kilos uh was giving me tunnel vision while I was doing the Reps

claim: A segunda tentativa de supino subiu muito mais devagar do que o esperado para o padrão dele.
verbatim: on the second attempt for anybody that knows about my benching uh this moved much slower than expected

claim: Ele ficou muito satisfeito de conseguir supinar 479 lb naquele dia.
verbatim: was thrilled at this point um to be able to bench 479

claim: Ele teve problemas de ombro naquele ciclo de treino e precisou tirar um tempo de folga.
verbatim: especially after some of the shoulder issues I've had in this training cycle and having to take time off

claim: Desaceleração forte no sticking point é, para ele, sempre um alarme de que o próximo salto de tentativa tem que ser pequeno.
verbatim: there's quite a bit of slowing um right through the sticking point which is right there and for me that always kind of sets off alarms that that next jump has to be pretty small

claim: Ele achou que tinha sido conservador o suficiente no salto, mas atribui a falha à viagem e à fadiga.
verbatim: I thought I was conservative enough with it but it just wasn't there on this day and and part of that's just doe I think to the travel and the fatigue

claim: Lidar com viagem e fadiga é algo que só se aprende quando se começa a competir nesse outro patamar.
verbatim: that's one of those things that you really have to learn about when you start competing at this this different level

claim: Quem está esperando ter um total grande para só então começar a competir não deve fazer isso, e sim entrar em competição e acumular experiência de plataforma.
verbatim: you're waiting to compete and you know you want this big total before you start competing in Powerlifting Meets don't do that get out there and start getting experiences with the meat

claim: A experiência de competição é incrivelmente valiosa.
verbatim: because that meat experience is so incredibly valuable

claim: A tentativa de supino perdida ficou perto: meia polegada mais alto e ele teria alcançado a posição de travamento.
verbatim: it was close on that bench uh just another you know half an inch higher and I'd have been able to get into the lockout position

claim: Quando se está se empurrando ao extremo absoluto, é preciso que tudo esteja funcionando perfeitamente.
verbatim: when you're pushing yourself to the absolute extreme you really need everything to be firing on all cylinders

claim: No abridor de terra o quadril dele subiu imediatamente e o levantamento saiu muito lento para um abridor.
verbatim: my hips rose out of the hole immediately very slow for an opening deadlift and it looked ugly

claim: Ele tinha levado o ouro no agachamento e no supino mesmo tendo perdido as segundas tentativas, mas ainda podia ser tirado do pódio geral.
verbatim: I had taken the gold and the squat in the bench even with missing my second attempts but at this point I could still be kicked off the podium

claim: Aquele terra não foi PR nem nada, mas foi a única terceira tentativa que ele validou no Mundial inteiro.
verbatim: it wasn't a PR it wasn't anything but it was the only third attempt that I make this entire meat

claim: A barra derivou cerca de 2 polegadas ao sair do chão, e ele puxou basicamente com a barra sobre os dedos dos pés.
verbatim: the bar off the floor drifts about 2 in um I pulled this deadlift from basically uh the bar being over my toes

claim: Ele terminou aquele terra sem forma nem proficiência técnica, no puro esforço, com o travamento prejudicado, mas sem hitch.
verbatim: I finished this lift basically with all heart uh no form uh no technical proficiency just gutted it out and you can see how the lockout was impacted there but didn't hitch
